scope: Evidence-based origin → final destination services from dated Renfe and SNCF trips and selected official endpoint publications. Coverage is partial, not every train or operator. Each direction is a separate route; repeat trips do not increase the route count. Countries are assigned by the origin station, so international routes are not duplicated.

frequencyMethod.basis: Scheduled full-train Renfe journeys whose first and last stops match this pair, in the displayed origin-to-final-destination direction, divided by seven days. Service calendars and exceptions applied. Identical endpoint departure/arrival times on the same day and direction are merged across train IDs and brands. Intermediate-stop journeys are excluded. Stored snapshot, not live operation.

distance.note: Rounded corridor estimate; not a verified mileage for every service or stopping pattern.

sncf-national.basis: Scheduled train departures in the displayed direction, averaged over 24–30 October 2026. Only full GTFS trips from their first to final station qualify.
